$comment: Waiting for components that haven't landed: field-demo, field-select and field-rtl (Select), field-slider (Slider). The unit that lands each ports its examples onto the Field page and maps them here.

field-choice-card.reason: A FieldTitle's line height. Upstream's cn() drops the field-title rule's leading-snug for the text-sm after it in Nova, so its title is 20px tall; scripts/port-styles.mjs keeps a rule's classes as written, so Joinery's is 19.25px and what follows each title sits 0.75px higher. Fixing it means port-styles.mjs applying tailwind-merge within each rule, as upstream's cn() does (the field-title rules, Sera's label and the combobox content, across the eight sheets).
